# ZTT (L23 µ∞) vs ZTT (TT2017 µ∞) — the M7 ladder (task 6)

*Generated by `design/py/run_ztt_l23.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

rRMS (%) in rrs space on L23 elastic (3320 scenes × 3 zeniths × 81 λ); held-out = the 664-scene split (seed 23). Each ladder step switches on one L23 term.

## Acceptance gate

ZTT (L23 µ∞) beats ZTT (TT2017 µ∞) on held-out scenes at each zenith: 0° ✅ (2.91 vs 4.26), 30° ✅ (2.56 vs 4.67), 60° ✅ (3.18 vs 8.11) — **PASS**.
